text:
ashwin (eng-ml): Heads-up: intake for model 'sable-11b-nc' — repo link https://huggingface.co/extern/sable-11b-nc. Looks like LICENSE = 'NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 1.0' per repo. Can we host/quantize?

leo (intake-bot): New model intake created: ID #1829 — sable-11b-nc — @ashwin added docs + weights link

jordan (mlinfra): If it's NC+ND that's a hard stop for hosted API. ND probably forbids modifying weights (including quant). Need legal read.

maya (legal): Can you paste the exact license text and model card lines? ND often prohibits derivative works; quantization may be considered a transformation. I'll review but likely not permitted without permission.

sara (evals): From evals POV, even running local evals should be fine, but we can't expose in hosted offering. Also need to check dataset licenses that trained it.

ashwin (eng-ml): Pasting LICENSE snippet:
```
NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 1.0
You may not use the material for commercial purposes. You may not create derivatives...
```
Also model card notes 'weights are released for research only'.

maya (legal): Ok that's explicit. Actions: (1) confirm 'commercial' definition in license (some allow research use in commercial orgs?), (2) confirm whether quantization or conversion to ONNX counts as derivative, (3) request explicit grant from licensor if we want hosted/dedicated. I'll draft a template permission request.

tessa (pm): If legal says no, we should still consider internal/private/on-prem offering for customers who arrange licensing directly — adding to intake: 'customer-managed license ok' checkbox. Logan: add to row #1829.

jordan (mlinfra): Quick grep that repo for 'derivative' and 'commercial' I ran:
```
curl -s https://huggingface.co/extern/sable-11b-nc/raw/main/LICENSE | grep -i "derivative\|commercial" -n
1:You may not use the material for commercial purposes.
2:You may not create derivatives.
```

maya (legal): Draft permission email: short, ask to confirm whether quantization/weight transforms constitute derivative and whether hosting (SaaS) is permitted. I'll paste draft shortly. If no reply in 7 days, escalate to product.

ashwin (eng-ml): :+1: Also note export control check — model includes dual-use medical examples? Sara, any red flags in model card datasets?

sara (evals): Model card references 'web-scrape-2023' and 'public forums' — no explicit restricted datasets, but we should run the dataset license scan. I'll add dataset links to intake.

leo (intake-bot): Updated intake #1829: license attached, legal requested permission, dataset scan requested.

maya (legal): Drafted email (sending now):
```
Subject: License clarification request — sable-11b-nc
Hi — we're evaluating sable-11b-nc for production use. The LICENSE indicates NonCommercial-NoDerivatives; could you confirm whether: (1) quantization/weight conversion, (2) hosted inference for paying customers, (3) distribution of quantized weights count as 'derivative' or require additional permission? Any guidance appreciated.
Best,
Maya, Legal — Redwood Inference
```

tessa (pm): :eyes: thanks Maya. If they grant quantization-only permission but no hosted SaaS, we can propose 'quantized weights for on-prem/dedicated only' clause.

jordan (mlinfra): FYI I also checked community threads — licensor has historically been open to 'non-commercial + research' only, but sometimes grants exceptions for enterprise via CLA. So expect back-and-forth.

ashwin (eng-ml): Cool. I'll pause any quant experiments until legal clears. Leaving a note in the experiment tracker: 'blocked by license clarification'.

sara (evals): :thumbsup:
